iOS Interview Preparation Guide - 110+ Questions & Answers

Complete iOS interview preparation resource covering Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI, architecture patterns, and advanced topics. Perfect for developers at all levels.

🍎 iOS Interview Preparation Guide

A comprehensive guide to prepare for iOS developer interviews, covering everything from basics to advanced topics with theory, practical examples, and 110+ real interview questions.

🎯 What You’ll Learn

  • Swift Programming: Optionals, closures, ARC, generics, and advanced Swift features
  • UIKit & SwiftUI: Modern iOS UI development with both frameworks
  • Architecture Patterns: MVC, MVVM, VIPER, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles
  • Advanced Topics: Concurrency, networking, security, performance optimization
  • Real Interview Questions: 110+ questions asked at Apple, Google, Meta, and top companies

📚 Complete Topic Coverage

🏗️ Core iOS Development

  • Introduction - Interview preparation strategies and tips
  • iOS Basics - App lifecycle, view controllers, and core components
  • Swift Programming - Language fundamentals and advanced features
  • OOP & Protocol-Oriented Programming - Design principles in Swift

🎨 User Interface Development

  • UIKit Development - Storyboards, Auto Layout, TableView, CollectionView
  • SwiftUI - Declarative UI, state management, animations

💾 Data & Networking

  • Data Persistence - UserDefaults, Keychain, Core Data, Realm
  • Networking - URLSession, REST APIs, Codable, Combine

⚡ Advanced Development

  • Multithreading & Concurrency - GCD, async/await, actors
  • Architecture & Design Patterns - Clean code and scalable apps
  • Dependency Management - SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage

🔧 Performance & Quality

  • Memory Management - ARC, retain cycles, optimization
  • Testing - Unit testing, UI testing, TDD/BDD

🔐 Specialized Topics

  • Advanced Topics - Combine, push notifications, deep linking
  • Security - Secure coding, SSL pinning, encryption
  • App Distribution & IAP - App Store deployment, In-App Purchases

🚀 Quick Start by Experience Level

👨‍💻 Entry Level (0-2 years)

Start with: Introduction → iOS Basics → Swift Programming → UIKit

👔 Mid-Level (2-4 years)

Focus on: Architecture Patterns, Networking, SwiftUI, Concurrency

🎖️ Senior (5+ years)

Deep dive: Design Patterns, Memory Management, Security, Performance

🏆 Architect/Lead

Master: Clean Architecture, SOLID Principles, System Design, Dependency Management
